mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 5.0%) consistently signals a strong labor market and robust corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates and compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of quarterly GDP growth above 11500 billion dollars (GDPC1) and industrial production above 110 (INDPRO) signals strong economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 > 11500 and INDPRO > 110.

mechanism_narrative: A monetary tightening cycle defined by federal funds rate above 4.5% (FEDFUNDS) and CPI index above 200 (CPIAUCSL) signals increased risk of recession and higher discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5 and CPIAUCSL > 200.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) signals strong manufacturing activity and corporate demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO > 110.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of employment growth above 137000 thousand persons (PAYEMS) and retail sales above 370000 million dollars (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 137000 and RSAFS > 370000.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 5.0% (UNRATE) signals labor market deterioration and reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of CPI index above 200 (CPIAUCSL) and retail sales above 370000 million dollars (RSAFS) signals strong economic activity despite inflation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 200 and RSAFS > 370000.
